description: This file contains test utility functions, classes, and mocks for socket connection testing in Chromium's network code, specifically for transport client socket pool unit tests. It defines mock socket factory behaviors, test functions for load timing, and socket address setup helpers.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory
classes.description: A mock socket factory class used for testing different socket connection behaviors in unit tests.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedReused
methods.description: Verifies that the handle sets load times correctly when a socket is reused.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedNotReused
methods.description: Verifies that the handle sets load times correctly when a socket is newly created.
